title: read_file
description: Input schema for the litany built-in `read_file` tool (ARCH §3.3, §12 v0.3 toolset). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

path.description: Filesystem path to the file to read. Relative paths resolve against the agent's current working directory.
